alt: New Shrek 5 animation still showing Shrek with a stunned expression, featuring the controversial redesigned softer, rounder character style with larger eyes
story: The Shrek 5 trailer dropped June 16, 2026, revealing redesigned characters with softer contours and Disney-large eyes — sparking such fierce backlash (#NotMyShrek, comparisons to 'AI slop') that Universal disabled YouTube comments entirely.
why_funny: A studio spent years redesigning an ogre who was already perfectly ugly, made him look like a knockoff Disney sidekick, then silenced everyone who noticed.
